subject: Alignment and transfer of data into data items
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (PB66 / D21). After normalization the significand aligns at the mask's point, truncates to the mask's digit count (-12345.678 into +9(3).9(2)E+999 → -123.45E+002 — six digits truncated to five) and zero-fills (1.5E+3 into +9.9(3)E+99 → +1.500E+03); the significand's simple / special / fixed insertion symbols (B 0 / , . +/-) render per §13.18.40.5 Table 7 and the exponent takes none; DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA exchanges the point and the grouping character in the image (-1,23456E+04; 1.234E+00 for 9.999E+99 in comma mode).
